# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 in volume 2, growing older by volume 3  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Domestic handmaiden and servant  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda has a snub nose, freckles, and an exceptionally broad mouth and grin. Formerly, she styled her hair in braids or crinkles bound with oversized, bright blue ribbon bows that looked like cherub wings, but later adopted a massive pompadour hairstyle as a young woman. Her appearance features a round waist and broad smiles, resembling her elder sisters to the extent that her mistress calls her Belinda despite it not being her birth name.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P27](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0027), [v2 c28 P72](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0072), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Belinda is an intensely devoted, hardworking, and affectionate handmaiden with a practical, matter-of-fact outlook on life. She displays a humorous habit of preparing for catastrophes while staying cheerful, diligent, and willing to follow her mistress's every whim. Though prone to accidental breakage of household items, she possesses deep loyalty, high energy, and a sincere admiration for Nell Harcourt.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c27 P27](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0027), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016)_

## History

Belinda went to live at Echo Cottage at age thirteen in exchange for room, board, and clothing, following three of her sisters in service to Miss Rosalind. Because of her strong resemblance to her sisters, her mistress called her 'Belinda the Fourth' rather than her actual name, Leonora. She assisted Miss Rosalind in maintaining the stone dwelling and hosting imaginary tea parties until Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke arrived. She formed a deep admiration for Nell, often practicing in front of her mirror to copy Nell's graceful movements and speech. When Miss Rosalind grew frail and lonely, Belinda expressed great concern to Nell and helped orchestrate the reunion of Miss Rosalind and Stephen Stanhope. Following Miss Rosalind's wedding to Stephen, Belinda moved to Boston along with the couple and Cedric, though she initially experienced homesickness and missed St. Brendan's Island. She returned to Echo Cottage each summer with the Stanhopes, maintaining her warm friendship and affectionate devotion toward Nell.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P49](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0049), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 c30 P32](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0032), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000), [v3 c40 P1](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual birth name is Leonora, given by her mother Mrs. Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest of the Bowman daughters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Succeeded her elder sisters Belinda (First), Julietta (Second), and Evelina (Third) in service at Echo Cottage at age thirteen  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
